name: GitHub CLI (gh)
instructions: Install Homebrew yourself using https://brew.sh, then rerun install.

name: gh-stack extension
instructions: Select GitHub CLI above, or install it yourself and rerun install. Configure authentication yourself if the native command requests it. Requires Git >=2.36.

name: gh-stack companion skill (separate from the extension)
instructions: Requires GitHub CLI with gh skill support. Select GitHub CLI above or update it yourself through its existing owner.

name: Herdr App
instructions: Requires Apple Silicon macOS and Homebrew. Install Homebrew yourself using https://brew.sh, then rerun install. Open Herdr App to complete any required herdr-core (hc) setup.

name: herdr-core companion skill (hc and Herdr App guidance)
instructions: Requires GitHub CLI with gh skill support. Select GitHub CLI above or update it yourself through its existing owner. This installs guidance only, not hc or Herdr App.

name: Zed editor
instructions: Install Homebrew yourself using https://brew.sh, then rerun install.

name: agent-browser (CLI + Chrome for Testing download)
instructions: Select your existing Node owner's npm on PATH, then rerun install.

name: agent-browser companion skill (separate from the CLI/browser)
instructions: Requires GitHub CLI with gh skill support. Select GitHub CLI above or update it yourself through its existing owner.
